workDescription: Designed and developed ESPS Trailer Parts, the online parts store for ESPS Trailers. Built on Shopify with a custom theme that carries the ESPS brand into e-commerce, the store organizes genuine parts for aluminum end-dump trailers into shoppable collections for tarps, valves, suspensions, liners and used parts, alongside brand collections for Hendrickson, Alkon, Roll-Rite, Sealco and Shur-Co. The storefront is optimized for every device, with a bottom navigation on mobile for quick access to search, shop, cart and account.
workTechnology: Shopify, Liquid, JavaScript, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Shop Pay
